lines.text: Via delle Fornaci 7 · Borgo Valdorso (TO) · Production plant
Date/time: 19/06/2001, 14:20. Location: disperser D-2, AF-12 lot
Event: flash fire at the open manhole during the white spirit
letdown. Batch temperature at letdown 58 °C (dispersion ran
longer on a hot day). White spirit vapour ignited, probable
static discharge from the PVC transfer hose.
Injuries: operator, first-degree burns to the right forearm.
Fire extinguished with CO2 in about 20 seconds.
Root cause: white spirit flash point is about 38 °C; at 58 °C
the batch was well above it and released flammable vapour.
